summary: This video details how to select the best free SSR Legendary hero from the Dragonheir web event. Skratch explains the alignment test mechanics, which feature 12 questions modifying Good-Evil and Law-Chaos scores across a grid of available heroes. He strongly advises targeting top-tier support heroes like Felosia or Synarell over damage dealers, whether to acquire them or for inspiration levels. He also warns against selecting low-impact heroes like Rhash or Victor, and explains how to answer the test questions to guarantee reaching the desired Lawful alignment cell.

heroes.name: Felosia

heroes.note: High-value support hero to prioritize from the Lawful alignment options.

heroes.note: Low-impact pick that should be avoided in favor of top-tier supports.

tips: Prioritize getting support heroes over damage dealers from the free event, as strong supports are harder to come by and provide long-term account value.
To target Felosia or Synarell, select positive Lawful options on questions to push your Law-Chaos alignment score to +4 or higher.
If using a creator invitation link to inherit a specific hero, do not start or complete the test in-game beforehand.
